note: Bank Central Asia (BCA), a reporting bank, on its own education page (4 October 2023, read 2026-10-30) about OJK's debtor information (iDeb) from the Financial Information Services System (SLIK): the lender gives the collectability score when it reports to OJK; collectability 2 marks arrears of 1 to 90 days, 3 of 91 to 120, 4 of 121 to 180 and 5 over 180; the score shown in the iDeb report is shown for 24 months (two years), written as keep two years (the period the report shows, as Djibouti's file uses). A secondary source: OJK's own pages and its regulations on SLIK (ojk.go.id, an F5 'Request Rejected' page; idebku.ojk.go.id; peraturan.go.id and peraturan.bpk.go.id, no answer or Cloudflare) weren't read, and the bank's page cites no article. No source read states how many days after its due date a missed payment is reported (the page says only that the lender scores it when it reports to OJK), so the days are the game's reading: the next monthly update.

sources.title: BCA Edukatips: Dampak Skor Informasi Debitur (iDeb) Buruk bagi Debitur Perbankan (4 October 2023)
sources.said: Skor ini pun diberikan oleh Bank/Lembaga jasa Keuangan yang memberikan kredit pada saat melaporkan data ke OJK ... tunggakan cicilan yang dimiliki oleh debitur masih berada dalam kurun waktu 1—90 hari ... Catatan : Skor yang tertera didalam laporan iDeb atau BI Checking akan ditampilkan selama kurun waktu 24 bulan/2 tahun. ... Masuk ke website SLIK OJK (https://idebku.ojk.go.id)
